```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidytext)
library(DT)
library(plotly)
library(gt)


source(here::here("02_IMDP_Figure_Generator/utils/initialise_plots.R"))

my.year = 2026



source(here::here("02_IMDP_Figure_Generator", "utils", "load_figure_data.R"))



dat = dat |> 
  mutate(Start_Time = as.POSIXct(
    Start_Time * 86400,
    origin = "1899-12-30",
    tz = "UTC"
  )) |> 
  mutate(End_Time = as.POSIXct(
    End_Time * 86400,
    origin = "1899-12-30",
    tz = "UTC"
  ))

## rename these to be Douglas
dat <- dat |>
  mutate(
    Station = if_else(
      (
        str_detect(Shift_Start_Comment, "DFO") |
          str_detect(Shift_End_Comment, "DFO")
      ) &
        as_date(TimeOfInspection) %in% as.Date(c(
          "2025-07-04", "2025-07-05", "2025-07-06",
          "2025-07-18", "2025-07-19",
          "2025-06-27", "2025-06-28",
          "2025-08-28", "2025-08-29", "2025-08-30"
        )) &
        Station != "Pacific",
      "Douglas Crossing",
      Station
    )
  )

dat_all = dat_all |> 
  mutate(
    Station = if_else(
      (
        str_detect(Shift_Start_Comment, "DFO") |
          str_detect(Shift_End_Comment, "DFO")
      ) &
        as_date(TimeOfInspection) %in% as.Date(c(
          "2025-07-04", "2025-07-05", "2025-07-06",
          "2025-07-18", "2025-07-19",
          "2025-06-27", "2025-06-28",
          "2025-08-28", "2025-08-29", "2025-08-30"
        )) &
        Station != "Pacific",
      "Douglas Crossing",
      Station
    )
  )

source(here::here("02_IMDP_Figure_Generator", "utils", "station_manipulation.R"))


### Okay lets fix some names

dat = dat |> 
  mutate(Station = case_when(
    Station == "Lower Mainland Roving - Douglas"      ~ "Douglas Crossing",
    Station == "Lower Mainland - Douglas"      ~ "Douglas Crossing",
    Station == "Lower Mainland - Huntington"      ~ "Sumas (Huntington)",
    Station == "Lower Mainland - Scheduled Inspection"      ~ "Lower Mainland",
    Station == "Lower Mainland Roving - Outreach"      ~ "Lower Mainland",
    Station == "Lower Mainland Roving - Huntington"      ~ "Sumas (Huntington)",
    TRUE ~ Station
  ))

dat_all = dat_all |> 
  mutate(Station = case_when(
    Station == "Lower Mainland Roving - Douglas"      ~ "Douglas Crossing",
    Station == "Lower Mainland - Douglas"      ~ "Douglas Crossing",
    Station == "Lower Mainland - Huntington"      ~ "Sumas (Huntington)",
    Station == "Lower Mainland - Scheduled Inspection"      ~ "Lower Mainland",
    Station == "Lower Mainland Roving - Outreach"      ~ "Lower Mainland",
    Station == "Lower Mainland Roving - Huntington"      ~ "Sumas (Huntington)",
    TRUE ~ Station
  ))

# source(here::here("02_IMDP_Figure_Generator", "utils", "dat_to_stations.R"))

stations_for_maps <- stations_for_maps |>
  dplyr::filter(station_name != "Radium")
station_labels = station_labels |> 
  dplyr::filter(station_name != "Radium")



source(here::here("02_IMDP_Figure_Generator", "utils", "get_basemaps.R"))

```

# Watercraft from Orgeon {.tabset}

```{r find_oregon}

dat_oregon = dat_all |> 
  filter(Previous_Waterbody_1_Province_Or_State == "OR") |> 
  filter(Year %in% c(2023, 2024, 2025, 2026))

dat_2023 <- dat_oregon |> 
  filter(Year == 2023)

dat_2024 <- dat_oregon |> 
  filter(Year == 2024)

dat_2025 <- dat_oregon |> 
  filter(Year == 2025)


dat_2026 <- dat |> 
  filter(Previous_Waterbody_1_Province_Or_State == "OR") |> 
  filter(Year == 2026)

```

## Summary Table 2023 - 2026

```{r}
summary_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  Year = c(2023, 2024, 2025, 2026),
  Watercraft = c(
    nrow(dat_2023),
    nrow(dat_2024),
    nrow(dat_2025),
    nrow(dat_2026)
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  summary_tbl,
  caption = paste(
    "Watercraft identified as being from Oregon.",
    "Total records (2023 to 2026):",
    nrow(dat_oregon)
  )
)
```


## Intercepting Station

```{r}

n_total <- nrow(dat_oregon)
n_station <- sum(!is.na(dat_oregon$Station))

tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c("Total Oregon watercraft",
             "Station recorded"),
  Count = c(n_total,
            n_station),
  Percent = c(
    100,
    100 * n_station / n_total
  )
) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(Count, decimals = 0) |>
  fmt_number(Percent, decimals = 1) |>
  cols_label(
    Percent = "% of total"
  )

```




```{r plot_interceptm, fig.width= 10, fig.height=8 }

dat_oregon_summary <-  dat_oregon |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Station)
  ) |>
  count(Year, Station, sort = TRUE, )



# ggplot(dat_oregon_summary,
#        aes(x = reorder(Station, n), y = n)) +
#   geom_col() +
#   facet_wrap(~Year, scales = "free_y") +
#   coord_flip() +
#   labs(
#     x = "Destination Waterbody",
#     y = "Number of Records",
#     title = "Destination Waterbodies for Oregon-Origin Boats"
#   ) +
#   theme_bw()

dat_oregon_summary <- dat_oregon_summary |>
  mutate(
    Station = forcats::fct_reorder(Station, n, .fun = sum)
  )

ggplot(
  dat_oregon_summary,
  aes(x = Station, y = n)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Year) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Records",
    title = "Intercepting Stations for Watercraft from Oregon"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

datatable(
  dat_oregon_summary,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    order = list(list(2, "desc"))  # sort by n descending
  ),
  caption = "Intercepting Stations for Watercraft from Oregon"
)

```

## Destination BC or not BC?

```{r bc_question}

dat_oregon_summary <- dat_oregon |>
  filter(!is.na(Destination_Waterbody_1_Province_Or_State)) |>
  count(Year, Destination_Waterbody_1_Province_Or_State)

n_total <- nrow(dat_oregon)
n_state <- sum(!is.na(dat_oregon$Destination_Waterbody_1_Province_Or_State))

tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Total Oregon watercraft",
    "Destination province/state recorded"
  ),
  Count = c(
    n_total,
    n_state
  ),
  Percent = c(
    100,
    100 * n_state / n_total
  )
) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(Count, decimals = 0) |>
  fmt_number(Percent, decimals = 1) |>
  cols_label(
    Percent = "% of total"
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Destination Province/State Information**")
  )

```



```{r}




p <- ggplot(
  dat_oregon_summary,
  aes(
    x = factor(Year),
    y = n,
    fill = Destination_Waterbody_1_Province_Or_State,
    text = paste0(
      "State/Province: ", Destination_Waterbody_1_Province_Or_State,
      "<br>Year: ", Year,
      "<br>Count: ", n
    )
  )
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Count", fill = "State / Province",
       title = "Destined Province/State for watercraft from Oregon 2023 - 2026") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")


```

## Destination of watercraft from Oregon



```{r plot_destination_waterbody_by_year,  fig.width= 10, fig.height=14  }

n_total <- nrow(dat_oregon)
n_destination_waterbody <- sum(!is.na(dat_oregon$Destination_Waterbody_1_Name))

tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Total Oregon watercraft",
    "Destination waterbody recorded"
  ),
  Count = c(
    n_total,
    n_destination_waterbody
  ),
  Percent = c(
    100,
    100 * n_destination_waterbody / n_total
  )
) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(Count, decimals = 0) |>
  fmt_number(Percent, decimals = 1) |>
  cols_label(
    Percent = "% of total"
  ) |>
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Destination Waterbody Information**")
  )

dat_oregon_summary <- dat_oregon |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Destination_Waterbody_1_Name)
  ) |>
  count(Year, Destination_Waterbody_1_Name, sort = TRUE, )

dat_oregon_summary <- dat_oregon_summary |>
  mutate(
    Destination_Waterbody_1_Name =
      fct_reorder(Destination_Waterbody_1_Name, n, .fun = sum)
  )

ggplot(
  dat_oregon_summary,
  aes(
    x = Destination_Waterbody_1_Name,
    y = n
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Year, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1)+
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Records",
    title = "Destination Waterbodies for Oregon-Origin Boats"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

datatable(
  dat_oregon_summary,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    order = list(list(2, "desc"))  # sort by n descending
  ),
  caption = "Destination Waterbodies for Oregon-Origin Boats"
)

```

## Destination of watercraft from Oregon - Top 10

```{r plot2 , fig.width= 10, fig.height=8 }

dat_top <- dat_oregon |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Destination_Waterbody_1_Name)
  ) |>
  count(Year, Destination_Waterbody_1_Name) |>
  group_by(Year) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 10) |>
  ungroup()

ggplot(
  dat_top,
  aes(
    x = reorder_within(Destination_Waterbody_1_Name, n, Year),
    y = n
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Year, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    title = "Top 10 Destination Waterbodies for Oregon-Origin Boats"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

dat_top_table <- dat_top |>
  rename(
    Year = Year,
    Destination_Waterbody = Destination_Waterbody_1_Name,
    Records = n
  ) |>
  arrange(Year, desc(Records))

datatable(
  dat_top_table,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  extensions = "Buttons",
  options = list(
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"),
    pageLength = 30,
    order = list(list(0, "asc"), list(2, "desc"))
  ),
  caption = "Top 10 Destination Waterbodies by Year for Oregon-Origin Boats"
)

```


## Specific Previous Waterbodies

```{r waterbody_destinations}

library(tibble)

waterbody_list <- tibble(
  waterbody = c(
    "Billy Chinook",
    "Prineville Reservoir",
    "Crescent Lake",
    "Lake of the Woods",
    "Cultus Lake",
    "Odell Lake"
  )
)

waterbody_list |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = "Waterbody",
    caption = "Previous Waterbodies filtered by: "
  )

dat_oregon |> 
  filter(
    tolower(Previous_Waterbody_1_Name) %in% tolower(waterbody_list)) |>
  select(Year, Watercraft_Risk_Assessment_ID, Previous_Waterbody_1_Name, Destination_Waterbody_1_Name) |> 
  knitr::kable()
  

```
